mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS `categoryId`, c.name AS `category`, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS `orderCount`, SUM(oi.quantity) AS `quantity`, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price), 0) AS `amount` FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed') GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY `amount` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.id AS `productId`, p.name AS `name`, p.image AS `image`, SUM(oi.quantity) AS `sales`, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price), 0) AS `amount` FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed') GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.image ORDER BY `sales` DESC LIMIT 10
